title: Elementary Particle Physics
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the lightest baryon and hence it is stable."
The proton is the lightest baryon and hence it is stable.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used to ascertain which reactions will occur in nature and which ones will not occur."
Conservation laws are used to ascertain which reactions will occur in nature and which ones will not occur.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the study of all natural phenomena and it deals with all laws of nature."
Physics is the study of all natural phenomena and it deals with all laws of nature.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means that reactions are equally capable of proceeding forward and backward."
Time-reversal invariance means that reactions are equally capable of proceeding forward and backward.
fib: ______ is the second force to be considered.
Electromagnetic force is the second force to be considered.
______ is any baryon containing one or more strange quarks, but no charm quarks or bottom quarks.
A hyperon is any baryon containing one or more strange quarks, but no charm quarks or bottom quarks.

______ refers to behavior under the transformation of particles into antiparticles while G parity refers to the behaviour under this same transformation compounded with a rotation by 1800 in isospin space.

C parity refers to behavior under the transformation of particles into antiparticles while G parity refers to the behaviour under this same transformation compounded with a rotation by 1800 in isospin space.
